reasoning: Shows a hollow circle below two concentric radiating arcs, universally understood as Wi-Fi, wireless internet, or a hotspot signal. It is a strong fit for home networking, ISP bills, router setup, and travel connectivity tasks, though it has low distinctiveness if the icon set also contains standard solid-dot or three-arc Wi-Fi icons.

pass1.ambiguity: Nearly identical to standard 3-bar or solid-dot Wi-Fi icons, making it completely interchangeable with other wireless signal glyphs at small sizes.
